_comment: TEMPLATE, not loaded by the site (file name starts with an underscore and is not listed in index.json). Copy it, rename it (e.g. set-01.json), fill it in, then add one entry to practice/index.json. Only question, options and correct_option are required. subject_area, difficulty (Moderate/Tough/Extreme), explanation, why_other_options_are_wrong, ailet_trap and language_trick are optional; sections without text are simply not shown. Questions are standalone, so use the flat 'questions' list. A 'passages' list (like the CLAT sets) also works if you ever need passage-based questions.

questions.question: EXAMPLE ONLY. Replace with your question text.
questions.explanation: Why the correct option is right.
questions.why_other_options_are_wrong: Option A fails because ... Option C fails because ... Option D fails because ...
questions.ailet_trap: The tempting wrong option mixes up X and Y.
questions.language_trick: The word 'only' makes option C wrong.
